data: This course introduces students to advanced econometric techniques for conducting empirical analysis in economics. It introduces students to several families of distributions and explores commonly used empirical approaches to identify causality. The course also features advanced topics such as instrumental variable estimation, panel data models, and limited dependent variables. At the end of this course, students should be able to have a deeper appreciation for the link between theory and empirical work, and also be able to engage meaningfully with current empirical literature in economics.
